g.title: Any domain-specific reasoner that ingests raw events, computes features, scores risk, and assembles a typed Observation. The ATO Reasoner is the reference implementation.
Inspects persisted Decision Bundles, replays decisions, and runs the 5-dimension evaluation harness.
OpenAI or Anthropic API. Serves the policy gate's structured-output calls and the eval harness's LLM-as-judge calls.
Governed decision framework: hybrid policy retrieval + LLM policy gate + deterministic enforcement, with append-only Decision Bundles for full audit replay.
